SAMPLE LETTER. This is a saved example, not a letter written for you. The live site writes a new one from your company, job title and job description.

Dear Hiring Team at Example Company,

I am writing about the Salesforce Architect role. I build and document Salesforce systems end to end, and this portfolio is one of them: every case study, skill and timeline entry on it is a record in my own Salesforce org, read through an allowlisted API and shown on this site.

In my recent work I led the design of integration and data models that other developers could pick up without me in the room. I write the decision down as I make it, I test the parts that break, and I keep the pipeline honest with deploys that fail loudly when something is wrong. That habit is what I would bring to your team.

I would welcome a conversation about where an architect who documents as carefully as they build could help Example Company.

Kind regards,
Ryan Bumstead
